The recently delivered chip, referred to as QPU, signifies a significant stride in the standardized mass production of this technology, marking a pivotal accomplishment in the field, the SCMP reports.
SpinQ has clients globally, including ones in the US, Canada, Australia, Britain, Germany, Switzerland, Norway, Slovenia, Russia, Brazil and Japan, among other regions, according to the SCMP.
The paper added that SpinQ has developed key technologies through independent research and development, – from chip design to complete machine and algorithm applications.

The paper also reports that SpinQ has three production lines: large superconducting quantum computers for industrial scenarios, small quantum computers for educational purposes and a general-purpose quantum cloud platform.
